evidence.claim: LPI reports 9,594 on the G70 test instance and 9,595 as a calibration value; the latter is not the reported test-instance score.
Cosm v4 reports the heuristic result 9,595 for G70 as best-known. The same abstract distinguishes certified optima for G81, G72, and G77 from heuristic results on G61 and G70.
Qian and Pan, v5 (revised 2021), report upper bounds and known best values for large UBPP instances; this is computational evidence, not a G70 optimality certificate.
The source reports numerical SDP value 9,683 for G70. This task has not independently certified it as an upper bound.

optimality.note: Cosm v4 reports a heuristic G70 cut of 9,595. LPI reports 9,594 on G70 test data and 9,595 as a calibration value. A 2019 paper reports numerical SDP value 9,683, which this task has not certified. The 88-point difference between the Cosm score and SDP figure is not a certified optimality gap. No checked source proves the G70 result optimal.
